text:
jordan: quick capacity check — need 8x H100 in eu-west1 for a throughput load test tomorrow 08:00-12:00 UTC. can we get a soft hold/reserve?

kalee: which tenant and expected p99 QoS? preemptible ok?

jordan: tenant: ad-platform-staging. target p99 ~120ms gen, throughput ~600 req/s. prefer non-preemptible. willing to accept 2 H100 preemptible as buffer.

pranay: talking to vendor. current eu-west H100 pool is tight. i can secure up to 6 guaranteed +2 on standby. ETA for confirmation ~3-4h. pinging vendor-sales@cloud.

vendor-bot: Vendor update: candidate rack allocation in queue. reserve hold requires P.O. or cc auth. reply with 'approve' to proceed with temporary hold.

jordan: @pranay ok please try to hold 6 guaranteed. i'll request credit approval.

sasha: finance OK to approve temporary hold up to €X/day. need cost center and expected hours.

jordan: cost center: infra-eng-loadtests. window: 4h tomorrow starting 08:00 UTC. rough estimate 6 H100 reserved = €XXXX. i'll post exact numbers.

kalee: if vendor can't confirm, fallback: 8x A100 mix with quantized 4-bit model we bench earlier — ~0.8x throughput but cheaper. @pranay can vendor give A100 fallback?

pranay: vendor says A100 fallback definitely available. would need different image/AMI. we can bake AMI overnight. can you add terraform snippet for preferred instance types?

jordan: adding snippet: ```hcl
resource "compute_instance_group" "loadtest" {
  count = var.h100_count
  machine_type = "n1-standard-32"
  accelerators { type = var.gpu_type count = var.gpu_count }
}
```

ops-oncall: heads-up: can we schedule a quick smoke on staging tonight to verify AMI and network egress? i'm oncall from 22:00 UTC.

jordan: yes. i'll run a small 2-GPU smoke at 22:30. @ops-oncall can you watch logs? i'll drop slack link with logs.

pranay: vendor confirmed soft hold for 12h if we submit cc auth. sending PO template to @jordan.

jordan: done — sent PO to procurement and cc'd @sasha. also tagging @kalee for patch that swaps GPU type via var.gpu_type.

sasha: :thumbsup: procurement flagged one compliance question about HSM key access for AMI; need to confirm no customer keys will be exposed.

jordan: confirmed — AMI will not contain customer keys. we'll use KMS-accessed secrets at runtime.

kalee: i'll open PR to add `gpu_fallback = "A100"` var and terraform plan will include both counts.

pranay: final vendor note: if H100 supply reduces <4, they'll auto-switch to A100 and notify within 30m. will post confirmation email.

vendor-bot: Reserve hold created: hold_id=HLD-20260306-8791 expires in 12h.

jordan: perf note: if fallback triggers, reduce batch_size 8->6 to keep p99. i'll update runtime config.

ops-oncall: i'll put a monitor alert for p99 > 200ms and cost spike > 20%.

kalee: :eyes: thanks. want PR link and i'll review later tonight.

pranay: i'll follow up in 2h with vendor's final allocation. thx.
